articles.title: Non-venture space startup investment hits post-SPAC high
articles.summary:
Non-venture investment in space startups surged last year to its highest level since a 2021 spike driven by a wave of special purpose acquisition company mergers, according to BryceTech analysis.

articles.title: CubeSats’ Missions Begin
articles.summary: NASA astronaut Chris Williams pointed a camera out a window on the cupola as a set of CubeSats were deployed outside the Kibo laboratory module by a small satellite orbital deployer into Earth orbit. Students from Mexico, Italy, Thailand, Malaysia, and Japan designed the shoe-boxed satellites for a series of Earth observations and technology demonstrations. articles.title: NASA’s Hubble Captures Light Show Around Rapidly Dying Star
articles.summary: This stunning image from NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope reveals a dramatic interplay of light and shadow in the Egg Nebula, sculpted by freshly ejected stardust. articles.title: Core Survey by NASA’s Roman Mission Will Unveil Universe’s Dark Side
